messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick preflight before I submit staging listings to AWS/GCP/Azure tomorrow morning. Need confirmation on packaging format, artifact access, and pricing SKU. @Tom @Priya @Lena

Tom Reynolds: Packaging: manifest.json + tar.gz (support files). For AWS include per-region AMI IDs; for GCP a compute image name; for Azure a storage blob URI. Keep manifest keys: version, artifacts->{region:{type, uri, sha256}}.

Priya Nair: CI will emit manifest + .sha256 files. Access pattern: short-lived assume-role for AWS, SAS tokens for Azure, and a GCP service account with objectViewer for the bucket path only. Use CMK and add a grant for marketplace decrypt.

Lena Ortiz: Legal: confirm SKU type (metered vs subscription). If we block specific territories, include export-control checkbox in listing. I'll post final SKU string before EOD.

OpsBot: OpsBot: manifest v2.1 uploaded to publisher-staging bucket ✅

Aisha Khan: OK scheduled to open portal 10:00 PT. Action items: Tom publish role/SAS runbook, Priya add KMS grant + CI validation, Lena finalize SKU. If no objections I9ll submit the staging listing then.
